title: System Control Board 3c: a trip is what the system couldn't fix; slow calls; the last Pulse cases as alarms
why: Decision 0171 release 3 (§5, §7, §8) with Jason's Trip rule (2026-11-18, the decision pop-up, reviewed by the session manager): 'a trip is when the system identifies a problem and can't resolve it: 1. internal testing and procedures to systematically resolve the issue. 2. pushing the issue to an admin and ceasing internal process until admin resolves it.' (1) THE SYSTEM TRIES FIRST: a crash (a server error, a task or run that failed, a job that stopped, a worker gone quiet) is a Warning saying which try it's on, for 3 tries or 1 hour, whichever comes first (control_fix_tries, control_fix_minutes in Thresholds & gates), then a Trip; a refusal or running out of budget trips at once. (2) TO AN ADMIN: the Founder emailed at once (§7), the Pulse item at the Director's level. (3) IT STOPS WHAT IT HOLDS, as narrow as its cause: a task that keeps failing stops only its workflow (new per-task alarms from each crawler run); a task, that task; out of budget, that service; a back-off at its limit, that server's calls; W0 gone quiet, W0; the master switch only when the crawler itself is down (runs failing outright or never reporting); a site job tied to no workflow only trips. The row says what it stopped. (4) ONLY AN ADMIN CLEARS IT: when its reading is good again the row says so and waits; Resolve (executive; starting again needs Automation's permission) asks what fixed it, runs the check and starts again only what the trip stopped; a check still red keeps it open with the reason on its row; Undo for a day; on the board and in Pulse. A person's Mark resolved or Reactivate closes it too; Overpass's trip is never cleared by a server answering. Warnings and notices still clear by themselves; trips raised before 3c keep the old behaviour until they clear. A red required pre-flight line is a trip only while what it holds is switched on. (5) 0171 §5 DETECTION: slow worker calls at the ledger (3× their usual, over a second) and slow site jobs, a warning, a trip after 3 in a row; a back-off at its case limit is a trip; job crashes counted per failed run. (6) §8: the last Pulse cases become alarms, one per thing with its buttons: each thing Starting the system waits on, W0 Indexer's needs (Reactivate, It's fine), a pre-flight run that stopped (Continue, Cancel). (7) §7: /api/health.php gains its alarms block (open trips and warnings, no person) for the session manager's hourly push. Migration 2026-11-18_control_alarms_trips.sql adds 8 columns to control_alarms (add-only, safe twice, skipped where the table isn't yet). 0171 §5 and §7 carry the notes. Not in 3c: the worker reporting its own retries (needs a worker change), and the cleanup fixes (the crawler-run page and W1 today, off-region sources, the release guards), next. Tests: r3c.php 28 (new), r3a 25 (updated to the rule), r3b 21, r2a 21, r2b 14, r2c 12, r2d 9, w2-verify 5, layout 8, r1 33, staging unit 59; rendered at 390px and 1280px with no sideways scroll, Resolve pressed (it asked what fixed it, then posted it).
